A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IFNalpha enhances B-cell migration through the modulation of chemokine receptor function and that this is mediated through the activation of PI3K, AKT, RhoA, NF-kappaB and ERK1.

The main takeaway from our work is that
IFNalpha enhances human B-cell migration to CCL20 and CCL21 by modulating chemokine receptor-induced signaling and by decreasing chemokine receptor endocytosis.
